label: Value Back Metric
title: Value Back Metric
summary: Use a Value Back Metric to show a rewards balance, such as JioPoints or cashback, with how to earn more and one next step.
corePrinciple: Name the programme, show the amount, offer one verb.

anatomy.title: Programme, amount, and a next step
anatomy.description: A left-aligned stack with the programme’s icon and name, the amount, a short caption, and a purple call to action. It has no surface or padding of its own.
blocks: Programme icon and name; always shown.
The amount, in the largest type.
One short line on how to earn or when it’s credited.
One purple verb, such as Earn.

configuration.title: Show only what helps
configuration.description: The header always shows. Add the value, caption, and call to action as the card needs them; each disappears when left out. The icon colour changes only the icon.

sizing.title: No wider than its column, at least 82 px tall
sizing.description: The card has no padding and is at least 82 px tall. It never grows wider than its column: in a narrow column the text wraps instead of overflowing, but short lines still read best.

content.title: Programme, amount, one verb
content.description: Use the programme name as the title, put the countable amount in the value, keep the caption to one short sentence, and make the call to action one verb in sentence case, such as Earn, View, or Claim.

inContext.title: Rewards on the home screen
inContext.description: Place one programme per card, side by side, with a distinct verb on each. The screen opens the programme when a call to action is pressed.

doDont.title: Keep it a clear rewards card
doDont.description: Each pair shows a card people understand versus one that confuses them.

sources.title: Use the public Value Back Metric contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (5 October build) from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s valueBack metric (122 × 83) stacks the JioPoints header, a value, a caption, and an Earn call to action. The package uses ic_rupee_coin as the default icon because the JioPoints mark is not in the icon set. The call to action is purple text, not a Link, so it has no underline. On the web, Enter and Space activate the call to action, and in a pressable card the call to action sits beside the card’s button, not inside it, so each press runs only its own action. Long lines wrap within the column.
